digest.component_or_area: file-impact data model and CLI/library surfaces
propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded: must distinguish 'author forgot' from 'no file impact intended', requiring a third state in the data model.

FILE_IMPACT event payload gains optional keys file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason; reducer state derives tri-state (undeclared/paths/none) from non-empty file_impact, empty file_impact with explicit scope, or neither.

CLI set-file-impact command must move from fixed-arity to variadic registry and support both --none with reason and JSON array forms; reason must have at least 10 non-whitespace characters or exit with usage error.
Library and MCP surfaces must expose get_file_impact_scope() returning {kind, reason, paths} and declare_no_file_impact() tool enforcing reason validation without modifying get-file-impact output.

State transitions between all three scope values (undeclared→paths→none→paths, etc.) must be mutually exclusive and apply both new keys on every FILE_IMPACT event through last-writer-wins in process_file_impact.
